resources.string: Miss Minutes cross-app automation

Lets Miss Minutes inspect the visible app screen and, only when you give a command, tap accessible controls and enter text. Screen content may be sent to your configured AI provider. It does not passively collect screen content.
Miss Minutes
Android system Assistant

Select Miss Minutes as your Android Assistant. Android can then keep its lightweight voice-interaction service available. This does not guarantee a wake phrase on every phone: hardware hotword support is device-dependent. Foreground screen content and screenshots remain disabled by default.

SMS intelligence

After Miss Minutes is selected as your Android Assistant and you grant SMS permissions, new messages are classified on this phone. Message text, sender addresses and verification codes are not stored or sent to an AI server. Only classification metadata is retained. Scanning existing inbox messages is a separate action.
